scientific_integrity: Complete analytic factorization proof and separate exact rational finite checks are supplied. The finite checks are not claimed to prove the general theorem. No authorship or independent verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the discrete Hu–Ivaki weighted facet graph for orthogonal products of full-dimensional origin-symmetric polytope factors, each of dimension at least two; not arbitrary Minkowski sums or smooth operators. The focal manuscript could not be fully inspected; equivalence in its unaccessed text remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Exact spectrum tensorization for centro-affine facet networks of convex-polytope products
